ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #9 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which sound does the Arabic letter ن make? (1 mark)
   A. n as in net
   B. j as in jug
   C. f as in fan
   D. d as in dog

2. What is the name of the Arabic letter ب? (1 mark)
   A. Haa
   B. baa
   C. siin
   D. dhaal

3. What does legible mean? (1 mark)
   A. Very fast
   B. Very small
   C. Written in colour
   D. Easy to read

4. Which Arabic word means "mother"? (1 mark)
   A. بِنْتٌ
   B. جَدٌّ
   C. أُمٌّ
   D. أَبٌ

5. What does the Arabic word مَطْبَخٌ (matbakh) mean? (1 mark)
   A. kitchen
   B. door
   C. key
   D. bag

6. What does the Arabic word كَبِيرٌ (kabiir) mean? (1 mark)
   A. maize
   B. Wednesday
   C. big
   D. cup

7. Which two letters begin the names of the days of the week in Arabic script (the word 'the')? (1 mark)
   A. baa and taa
   B. miim and nuun
   C. alif and laam
   D. siin and shiin

8. Which letter is missing in الجم_ة? (1 mark)
   A. ع (ʿayn)
   B. غ (ghayn)
   C. ح (Haa)
   D. ف (faa)

9. Which Arabic sentence means "We dance." (1 mark)
   A. عِنْدِي هَدِيَّةٌ
   B. أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ الطَّعَامَ
   C. أَنَا أُحِبُّ الْحَفْلَةَ
   D. نَحْنُ نَرْقُصُ

10. Which Arabic word means "cake"? (1 mark)
   A. أُغْنِيَةٌ
   B. رَقْصٌ
   C. كَعْكَةٌ
   D. عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ

11. Which style is old, angular and has straight lines? (1 mark)
   A. Diwani
   B. Kufic
   C. Ruqʿah
   D. Naskh

12. Which Arabic word means "apples"? (1 mark)
   A. صَدِيقٌ
   B. جَدَّةٌ
   C. تُفَّاحٌ
   D. رِجْلٌ

13. Which Arabic word means "fish"? (1 mark)
   A. خُضَارٌ
   B. بُرْتُقَالٌ
   C. سَمَكٌ
   D. بَيْضٌ

14. What does the Arabic word شَعْرٌ (shaʿr) mean? (1 mark)
   A. heart
   B. finger
   C. hair
   D. mouth

15. Which Arabic sentence means "I clean my teeth." (1 mark)
   A. رَأْسِي كَبِيرٌ
   B. يَدِي صَغِيرَةٌ
   C. أَغْسِلُ وَجْهِي
   D. أُنَظِّفُ أَسْنَانِي

16. Which of these is unique about Arabic writing? (1 mark)
   A. It has no dots
   B. It is written from right to left
   C. It has capital letters
   D. It has 26 letters

17. What does the Arabic word مَطَرٌ (matar) mean? (1 mark)
   A. wind
   B. weather
   C. rain
   D. sunny

18. How does rain help people? (1 mark)
   A. It stops all farming
   B. It makes crops die
   C. It has no use
   D. It helps crops to grow and gives us water

19. What does the Arabic sentence فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. In the kitchen there is a table.
   B. I like my house.
   C. This is my room.
   D. In the room there is a bed.

20. What does the Arabic sentence بَيْتِي كَبِيرٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my room.
   B. In the kitchen there is a table.
   C. In the room there is a bed.
   D. My house is big.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Name three Arabic writing styles and state one use of one of them. (3 marks) (3 marks)

22. Translate into English: ash-shamsu haarra (2 marks)

23. Explain how drawing and labelling help you to remember new words. (2 marks) (2 marks)

24. Write one Arabic sentence about today's weather in sounds and translate it. (2 marks) (2 marks)

25. Write two Arabic sentences in sounds about a celebration and translate them. (4 marks) (4 marks)

26. Name three things that make Arabic writing different from English writing. (3 marks) (3 marks)

27. Translate into English: al-baabu kabiir (2 marks)

28. Describe the steps for learning to write a new letter. (4 marks) (4 marks)

29. Give two ways of taking care of your body. (2 marks) (2 marks)

30. Put the words in order and translate: كَبِيرٌ / بَيْتِي. (2 marks) (2 marks)

31. Translate into English: an-naafidhatu nadhiifa (2 marks)

32. Translate into English: raʾsii kabiir (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #9 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — n as in net
   The letter ن makes the sound n as in net.

2. B — baa
   The letter ب is called baa.

3. D — Easy to read
   Legible writing can be read easily by other people.

4. C — أُمٌّ
   أُمٌّ (umm) means mother.

5. A — kitchen
   مَطْبَخٌ (matbakh) means kitchen.

6. C — big
   كَبِيرٌ (kabiir) means big.

7. C — alif and laam
   al- is written with alif and laam.

8. A — ع (ʿayn)
   The word is الجمعة, al-jumuʿa, Friday.

9. D — نَحْنُ نَرْقُصُ
   نَحْنُ نَرْقُصُ (nahnu narqusu) means: We dance.

10. C — كَعْكَةٌ
   كَعْكَةٌ (kaʿka) means cake.

11. B — Kufic
   Kufic is an old angular style used for decoration and old manuscripts.

12. C — تُفَّاحٌ
   تُفَّاحٌ (tuffaah) means apples.

13. C — سَمَكٌ
   سَمَكٌ (samak) means fish.

14. C — hair
   شَعْرٌ (shaʿr) means hair.

15. D — أُنَظِّفُ أَسْنَانِي
   أُنَظِّفُ أَسْنَانِي (unadhdhifu asnaanii) means: I clean my teeth.

16. B — It is written from right to left
   Arabic runs from right to left and has 28 letters and no capitals.

17. C — rain
   مَطَرٌ (matar) means rain.

18. D — It helps crops to grow and gives us water
   Rain waters crops and fills rivers and tanks.

19. A — In the kitchen there is a table.
   فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ (fii l-matbakhi taawila) means: In the kitchen there is a table.

20. D — My house is big.
   بَيْتِي كَبِيرٌ (baytii kabiir) means: My house is big.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example Naskh, Ruqʿah and Kufic. Naskh is used in printed books.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each style named (up to 2) and 1 mark for a correct use.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: The sun is hot.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: The picture shows the meaning and writing the label practises the spelling.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example al-jawwu baarid. The weather is cold.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a correct sentence and 1 mark for the translation.

25. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example haadhihi hafla. This is a party. ʿindii hadiyya. I have a gift.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence and 1 mark for each translation.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: It is written from right to left; it has no capital letters; most letters join and change shape; short vowels are shown with marks.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid difference.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: The door is big.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: Trace the model; copy it several times from right to left; write it from memory and compare; add and check the dots.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: Wash hands and face; clean teeth; eat good food; sleep well.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible way.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: بَيْتِي كَبِيرٌ. My house is big.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order and 1 mark for the translation.

31. (2 marks)
   Answer: The window is clean.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: My head is big.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.
